name: task_cancel
description: Cancel a queued task by id. Marks it status=cancelled but keeps it in the queue as a record (use task_delete to remove). Matches the full id or a unique prefix.

name: task_delete
description: Delete a queued task by id, removing it from the queue entirely. Matches the full id or a unique prefix.

name: task_run
description:
Pick up a queued task and run it through the Convergence Loop (Kernel) — the honest
    consumer for the queue. Claims the named task (full id or unique prefix) or the top
    pending task, marks it active (so active_slots reflects real in-flight work), routes it
    to the TOOL-ENABLED streaming chat path (Reason/Act) so the model (Gemini/Claude/OpenAI)
    can actually call repo tools — Read/Grep/Glob plus operator Edit/Write/Bash on loopback —
    instead of only proposing text, then writes an append-only Convergence Record + PCSF
    receipt (Verify/Converge) and marks it done. Tool execution requires CHAT_TOOL_EXEC=1 on
    the garage server. Per the LANTERN-DREAM rule, results are PROPOSALS: confidence is capped
    at 0.3 until Σ₀-verified. tool_calls reports how many tools the model executed.

    Pass `provider` (e.g. "gemini", "claude", "openai", "grok", "ollama") to PIN the
    reasoner instead of auto-routing; it is forwarded to the streaming chat as the
    request `provider`. Empty = auto-route (PCSF leaderboard). Loopback POST = operator,
    so the pinned provider gets the full toolset.

name: execute_task
description:
SUPERFLEET PHASE 3 — sandboxed EXECUTOR. Upgrades a claimed task from a
    PROPOSAL into an executed change: claim a queued task → carve a git-worktree
    SANDBOX off the base branch → run the local Σ₀/convergence coder → run bounded
    in-house verification (py_compile / node --check) → on success commit + push a
    NEW fix branch (never auto-merged) → emit a Convergence Record + PCSF receipt;
    on failure record the failure pattern. The worktree is always auto-cleaned.

    OPT-IN + BOUNDED: refuses unless SUPERFLEET_EXECUTOR=1 (the default queue
    consumer remains task_run, the proposal generator). Push is a second opt-in
    (SUPERFLEET_EXECUTOR_PUSH=1); otherwise it commits to the branch only. Pass
    dry_run=1 to prove the whole flow without committing/pushing or mutating the
    real repo (sandbox created + removed only).

name: queue_clear
description: Clear the work queue. With no args removes ALL tasks; pass status (e.g. pending, cancelled) to remove only tasks in that state. Returns how many were removed.

name: boot_check
description: Check orchestrator boot status. Reports honest slot counts from fleet status file.

name: list_skills
description: List available skills. Does not include fleet agents — see fleet_status for agent fleet.

name: get_status
description: Overall system status with honest fleet counts loaded from fleet status file.

name: fleet_status
description:
Read the agent fleet status directly from data/status/super-jarvis-fleet.json.
    Returns designed ring slot count, active vs sleeping slots, and the claim boundary.
    Active slots = 0 means all agents are in sleep/design mode, not live workers.

name: mesh_register_peer
description: Register a peer node in the P2P mesh. Peers may donate resources (agent slots, compute).

name: mesh_status
description: Show P2P mesh topology: founder, peers, and aggregate donated resources.

name: mesh_donate
description: Update the resources a peer is willing to donate (opt-in).

name: mesh_prune
description: Remove stale peers that haven't sent a heartbeat. Founder-only control.

name: update_lantern_os
description: Pull latest master, install dependencies, and optionally restart the server.

name: research_run
description:
Run the research convergence loop for one question: web-search the evidence,
    persist it as memory, extract claims, verify each by cross-source corroboration
    (External Reality Rule), and return a cited report carrying, for every claim,
    [claim, evidence, confidence, source].

name: research_intake
description:
Queue a research question for the continuous research program (durable JSONL
    queue that survives restarts). Drain it with research_run_next.

name: research_run_next
description:
Run the highest-priority pending research task from the queue through the
    convergence loop. Returns the cited report, or a queue_empty note.

name: research_status
description: Show the research program queue depth and per-status task breakdown.

name: mcp_capability_status
description:
Self-diagnosing capability map for THIS MCP server — for each capability that
    gates real work, report whether it is available, the blocker if not, and the
    concrete next_action to enable it. An honest Observe/Verify surface (ported from
    the orchestrator's get_mcp_capability_status): every field is read from live
    process state — env flags, module-import success, the Node runtime — never
    fabricated. Opt-in capabilities (off by design) are flagged and excluded from
    known_gaps so a deliberate default isn't reported as a defect.

name: github_get_me
description: Get the authenticated GitHub user's profile (login, name, plan, counts).

name: github_get_file_contents
description: Read a file or directory from a repo. Returns decoded text for files, a listing for dirs.

name: github_create_or_update_file
description: Create or update a single file (one commit). Provide sha to update an existing file.

name: github_delete_file
description: Delete a file from a repo (one commit). Looks up the blob sha if not provided.

name: github_push_files
description:
Commit multiple files in a single atomic commit.

    files: JSON array string, e.g. '[{"path":"a.txt","content":"hi"}]'.
    Uses the Git Data API (tree + commit + ref update).

name: github_create_branch
description: Create a new branch from an existing one (defaults to the repo's default branch).

name: github_list_branches
description: List branches in a repository.

name: github_list_commits
description: List commits on a branch/ref, optionally filtered by file path.

name: github_get_commit
description: Get a single commit's details, stats, and changed files.

name: github_create_repository
description: Create a new repository for the authenticated user.

name: github_fork_repository
description: Fork a repository into the authenticated user's account (or an org).

name: github_create_release
description: Create a new release (and optionally a new tag).

name: github_get_latest_release
description: Get the latest published release of a repository.

name: github_list_releases
description: List releases for a repository.

name: github_search_code
description: Search code across GitHub using GitHub code-search syntax.

name: github_search_repositories
description: Search repositories by name, topic, language, stars, etc.

name: github_search_issues
description: Search issues and pull requests using GitHub search syntax.

name: github_search_users
description: Search GitHub users and organizations.

name: github_list_issues
description: List issues in a repository (filter by state: open/closed/all, and labels).

name: github_get_issue
description: Get a single issue with its body and metadata.

name: github_create_issue
description: Open a new issue. labels/assignees are comma-separated.

name: github_update_issue
description: Update an issue's title/body/state (open/closed) or replace its labels.

name: github_add_issue_comment
description: Add a comment to an issue or pull request.

name: github_list_issue_comments
description: List comments on an issue or pull request.

name: github_update_issue_comment
description: Update the body of an existing issue or PR comment.

name: github_delete_issue_comment
description: Delete an issue or PR comment by its comment id.

name: github_list_pull_requests
description: List pull requests (state: open/closed/all).

name: github_get_pull_request
description: Get a pull request. Set include_diff=true to also return the unified diff (truncated).

name: github_create_pull_request
description: Open a new pull request from head into base.

name: github_update_pull_request
description: Update a PR's title/body/state (open/closed) or base branch.

name: github_merge_pull_request
description: Merge a pull request. merge_method: merge | squash | rebase.

name: github_create_pull_request_review
description: Submit a PR review. event: APPROVE | REQUEST_CHANGES | COMMENT.

name: github_get_pull_request_files
description: List files changed in a pull request with patch stats.

name: github_add_pull_request_review_comment
description:
Add an inline review comment to a specific line in a PR diff.

    commit_id: the SHA of the commit to comment on.
    path: relative path to the file.
    line: line number in the diff (leave blank to attach to the overall diff hunk).
    side: RIGHT (new file) or LEFT (old file).

name: github_get_pull_request_status
description: Get the combined CI status and check runs for a pull request's head commit.

name: github_list_workflows
description: List GitHub Actions workflows defined in a repository.

name: github_list_workflow_runs
description: List recent workflow runs (optionally for a specific workflow id or filename).

name: github_get_workflow_run
description: Get details of a single workflow run, including jobs summary.

name: github_run_workflow
description: Trigger a workflow_dispatch run. workflow_id is the file name (e.g. ci.yml) or numeric id.

name: github_get_job_logs
description: Fetch the logs for a single Actions job (truncated to the tail).

name: github_list_notifications
description: List inbox notifications. all=true includes read; participating=true filters to @-mentioned.

name: github_get_notification_thread
description: Get a single notification thread by its id.

name: github_mark_notification_read
description: Mark a notification thread as read.

name: github_dismiss_notification
description: Dismiss (unsubscribe from) a notification thread so it no longer appears in the inbox.

name: local_repo_status
description:
Git status of the canonical local checkout: branch, sha, dirty files, ahead/behind.
    Read-only.

name: local_repo_search
description:
Search the local checkout for a regex/string (ripgrep if available, else stdlib).
    Read-only. Optional `glob` filters filenames (e.g. '*.py').

name: local_file_read
description:
Read a file from the local checkout. Refuses path traversal and forbidden paths
    (.env*, secrets, keys, private data).

name: local_worktree_create
description:
Create an isolated git worktree on a bot-owned branch (mcp-local/<task_id>) off
    `base`. This is the only place edits are allowed — never the live working tree.

name: local_worktree_destroy
description: Remove a task worktree and its bot branch.

name: local_patch_apply
description:
Apply a unified diff inside the task's worktree, after deterministic safety checks:
    target files must not be forbidden, must match `allowed_globs` (comma-separated, if
    given), and the added lines must contain no secrets. Never touches a protected branch.

name: local_test_run
description:
Run an ALLOWLISTED test/lint command (pytest, node --check, npm test/lint, ruff,
    mypy, git diff --check). Runs in the task worktree if task_id given, else the repo.
    Arbitrary shell is refused.

name: recipe_list
description: List the deterministic repair recipes (fixed playbooks per issue class).

name: recipe_run
description:
Return the deterministic contract + execution plan for a recipe. This is the router:
    it hands the fixed contract (observe/allowed_edits/required_tests/forbidden/done_when)
    and the exact next-tool sequence to the caller. Edits still flow through
    local_patch_apply (validated) and local_test_run (gated) — the contract is the boss.

name: worker_status
description: Report the local runner state: repo root, active task worktrees, receipt count.

name: receipt_get
description: Fetch all receipts for a task id (the replay/audit trail).

name: local_git_status
description:
Current branch, modified/staged/untracked file counts, ahead/behind remote,
    and a risk assessment (low/medium/high) for mutation operations.

name: local_worktree_risk
description:
Git status + risk level summary for safe mutation decisions.

    Returns risk: low | medium | high with a human-readable reason.
    High = protected branch or large pending changes.
    Medium = behind remote or many staged files.
    Low = clean feature branch.

name: local_git_create_branch
description:
Create and checkout a new feature branch.

    branch: name for the new branch (refused if it matches master/main/dev/production/release).
    from_ref: base ref/SHA (default: current HEAD).
    dry_run: 'true' (default) just validates; 'false' creates the branch.

name: local_git_stage_files
description:
Stage specific repo-relative file paths for the next commit.

    paths: comma-separated repo-relative paths (e.g. 'src/foo.py,README.md').
    Absolute paths, globs, and path traversal (../) are refused.
    dry_run: 'true' (default) just validates; 'false' stages the files.

name: local_git_commit
description:
Commit currently staged files.

    Refused on master/main/dev/production/release.
    dry_run: 'true' (default) shows what would be committed; 'false' commits.

name: local_git_push
description:
Push the current branch to remote.

    Refused on master/main/dev/production/release.
    set_upstream: 'true' (default) passes -u to set tracking.
    dry_run: 'true' (default) shows what would be pushed; 'false' pushes.

name: local_git_open_pr
description:
Open a GitHub pull request for the current branch via the gh CLI.

    base: target branch (default master). Current branch is the head.
    draft: 'true' opens as a draft PR.
    dry_run: 'true' (default) shows the plan; 'false' opens the PR.

name: local_server_status
description:
Check which local Keystone servers are up (ports 4177, 4178, 8771)
    and return the MCP server's own uptime.

name: get_tunnel_canary
description:
Probe the MCP tunnel endpoint (mcp.lantern-os.net) via a lightweight
    tools/list call to confirm end-to-end tunnel health.

    Returns ok=True with latency_ms if reachable, error otherwise.
    Read-only — never mutates anything.

name: get_recent_task_failures
description:
Return the most recent failed/cancelled tasks from the queue ledger.

    Reads data/queue/ledger.jsonl (or equivalent) for status=failed|cancelled events.
    limit: max records to return (default 10).

name: convergence_run
github_triage_prs
description:
Pull open PRs + their checks/mergeability and return a ranked queue
    (ready first, conflicting last) — the missing 'PR issues' brain.

name: github_pr_status
description:
Return mergeability, checks, blockers, labels, and the recommended next
    action for one PR — one clean call instead of five.

name: github_work_issue
description:
Work a GitHub issue under hard safety gates.

    mode=investigate : read the issue + record a fix_plan. NO writes.
    mode=patch       : investigate + create a bot branch (MCP_BOT_BRANCH_PREFIX)
                       + push proposed file_changes. NO PR, NO merge.
    mode=pr          : patch + open a PR into MCP_DEFAULT_BASE_BRANCH. NEVER merges.

    Safety (hard refuse → error dict): repo not allow-listed; writes disabled
    (github_tools.WRITE_ENABLED False); any attempt to write the base branch.
    Every action is appended to data/convergence/issue-work-records.jsonl.

name: github_fix_failed_checks
description:
Inspect a PR's failed checks and propose/apply a fix under safety gates.

    Reuses github_pr_status + github_get_job_logs to build a fix_plan.
    create_pr=True (DEFAULT, SAFER): create a STACKED bot fix branch and open a
    NEW PR — never touches the original branch. Only when create_pr=False AND the
    original branch is clearly bot-owned (starts with MCP_BOT_BRANCH_PREFIX) do we
    push directly to it.

    Safety (hard refuse): repo not allow-listed; writes disabled; any attempt to
    write the base branch; never merges. Receipts → pr-work-records.jsonl.

name: worker_tick
description:
Claim and run up to N pending tasks once. Proves queue pickup without a
    daemon — each task goes pending → active → done/failed, so active_slots
    becomes meaningful while it runs.

name: lantern_command
description:
Execute a Lantern bang command through the MCP backend the UI expects.
    Routes: !convergance/!convergence→convergence_run, !autonomous-work N→investigate,
    !pr-status N→github_pr_status, !triage-prs→github_triage_prs, !fix-pr N→status+plan,
    !queue-run [N]→worker_tick.
